name: SCENEBench
description: SCENEBench is an audio understanding benchmark suite targeting broad audio comprehension beyond speech recognition, including background sound understanding, noise localization, cross-linguistic speech understanding, and vocal characterizer recognition. It is grounded in assistive and industrial use cases and includes both synthetic and natural audio samples for ecological validity.
reputation: A very recent audio-understanding benchmark suite with limited public adoption so far, mainly notable for broadening evaluation beyond speech recognition.
notes: Includes four real-world audio comprehension categories; validated with natural audio samples; reveals critical gaps in current large audio language models.
